notes: Japan-market page (nintendo.co.jp), model JAN-001; 'Newニンテンドー2DS LL' in Japan. Despite the '2DS' name this model DOES fold — Nintendo's サイズ line carries （折りたたみ時）'when folded', so hinge.type=clamshell is sourced; the '2DS' in the name refers to the absence of autostereoscopic 3D, not to the 2DS's slate form factor. Axis mapping: Nintendo lists 縦86.36mm×横159.36mm×厚さ20.8mm; height=横159.36 (long axis), width=縦86.36, depth=厚さ20.8 — Nintendo's own label for the long axis is 'width' (横). Closed/folded state; open state not published, left null. TOP SCREEN IS 400x240, NOT 800x240: no 3D panel, so Nintendo's line reads 横400ドット×縦240ドット (aspect 5:3), while the diagonal (4.88型) and active area (106.2x63.72 mm) match the New 3DS XL's top screen. Quoted, not inferred. ACTIVE AREA IS PUBLISHED, NOT DERIVED: printed in mm inline with each diagonal, so 'derived' is deliberately FALSE. MASS CAVEAT: Nintendo's inclusion list here is 約260g（タッチペン・microSDカードを含む） — stylus and microSD card only. Every other model in this family states バッテリーパック (battery pack) in its inclusion list; this page does not, and its 使用電源 row likewise names a バッテリーパック with no part number. Whether the 260 g figure includes the battery is therefore NOT established by the source; the figure is recorded verbatim and the ambiguity flagged rather than adjusted. CONTROLS: New-generation set with ZL/ZR and the Cスティック, hence bumper count 4 and stick count 2; positions not stated by Nintendo, left null. HOME and power buttons appear under その他入力 with no matching enum kind. ports: microSD explicitly stated; game card slot and AC adapter connector omitted (no matching enum kind); the 3.5 mm diameter is not stated by Nintendo. Speakers are on the LOWER screen (下画面左右のステレオスピーカー), unlike the 3DS/3DS XL/New 3DS XL which place them beside the upper screen. Supports NFC and has no 3D depth slider. released = Japan launch; the North American/European launch (2017) is not sourced from a Nintendo page, left out. announced: not sourced, null. refresh_hz, materials, corner_radius, depth_at_hinge: not published, null.
